introduction.p: Frances and Camilla are co-owners of a pastry shop. Frances bakes pies and Camilla bakes cakes. Frances is able to bake p pies each day she works and Camilla is able to bake c cakes each day she works.
One month, Frances worked 17 days and Camilla worked 20 days. That month they produced {17p+20c} baked goods in total.

statement.p: The next month, Frances worked 21 days and Camilla worked 19 days. How many baked goods did they produce that month?
How many baked goods was that in total for those two months?
